verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing community mention of 'CloudSQL databases' in the Google Cloud console, which suggests a first-party managed relational database exists but documents none of its operational features. The MCP Toolbox for Databases only connects agents to databases and is not a managed database service, so it is not credited. missing for 10: first-party docs for managed relational offerings, automated backups, HA/failover options, documented maintenance windows, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, the database is a service — managed relational offerings with automated backups, HA options, and documented maintenance windows

citations.quote: you don't have your Kubernetes clusters and CloudSQL databases
